items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: And while we were there Jake Hanna came in. And Jake went over and gave him a hug

ctx.x: I really enjoyed your perspective on him because—

It’s different from what you — I mean it’s unreal. When he was in the hospital I remember going to see him. I was on my way to Europe and Chuck Findley and I and Joe Romano to see him. We had a ride to the airport so we stopped at UCLA and this was just after his operation, and his left arm was gone, his left arm was totally paralyzed. We never saw him again. He had died while we were in Europe and his left arm was paralyzed. And he’d be laying there. And every time he’d yawn, his arm would raise. There was…
